bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears finalized their 53-man roster and practice squad ahead of Week 1, with notable moves including the trade of Gervon Dexter Sr. to the Atlanta Falcons for Clark Phillips III and a draft pick , while also placing defensive back Coby Bryant and tight end Hayden Large on Reserve/Injured, and signing defensive lineman James Lynch and linebacker Jack Sanborn to the active roster .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions have been finalizing their roster ahead of the 2026 season, announcing 14 additions to the practice squad, including names like Luke Altmyer and Tom Kennedy, while also signing offensive lineman Elijah Klein after final roster cuts. GM Brad Holmes also addressed the team's health outlook, expressing hope that key defenders safeties Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch along with backup running back Isiah Pacheco will be healthy enough to play this season , though he declined to share a specific timetable for each player's potential return .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest ongoing story continues to dominate Packers coverage this week: running back Josh Jacobs remains sidelined after being placed on the NFL commissioner's exempt list while two misdemeanor charges against him are pending, a move that prevents him from practicing or attending games , leaving Green Bay thin at the position ahead of its season opener. To address the shortage, the Packers tried to address their running back shortage Sunday by acquiring 2025 third-round pick Kaleb Johnson from the Pittsburgh Steelers in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round selection , and the team has since been ramping up practices at Clarke Hinkle Field as it prepares for its Week 1 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings continued shuffling their roster after finalizing their 53-man squad, releasing QB Max Brosmer and WR Dillon Bell to make room for waiver claims OG Trevor Keegan and C Nick Samac. Quarterback Max Brosmer and wide receiver Dillon Bell were both released to make room for waiver additions offensive guard Trevor Keegan and center Nick Samac.
